about_the_game:
Overview

The trees stand silent sentinels as wary residents stalk the unwelcome. In the shadows, an ancient demon waits—patient, relentless—for the final ember to die. Only by keeping the flame alive can the darkness be held at bay.

Chosen to perform an ancient ritual reserved for the few, you must keep the fire roaring through the long night until dawn. Only its relentless blaze holds the veil of reality at bay—preventing it from tearing open and unleashing an unspeakable evil.

Depending on how you fare, your story can end in multiple ways. I trust you will complete your task diligently —before darkness engulfs your world.

Features

  • Immersive First-Person Horror – Step into the darkness and experience the fear directly through your own eyes, surrounded by an atmosphere of dread and unease.

  • Dynamic Movement – Run to escape danger, jump across obstacles, or move silently by sneaking to avoid detection from lurking threats.

  • Interactive Environment – Pick up objects scattered across the world and use them to fuel the flames of the fire.

  • Torches and Firelight – Take torches from the fire to light your way through the suffocating darkness.

  • Haunting Forest Exploration – Wander a sprawling, eerie forest map where every path hides secrets, dangers, and the constant uncertainty of what may be watching.

  • Survival-Driven Gameplay – Every action matters. Managing light and movement can mean the difference between life and death.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains horror themes and frightening imagery that may not be suitable for all audiences. Players can expect:

Intense Atmosphere – Dark environments, unsettling sounds, and jump scares.

Violence and Disturbing Content – Depictions of threat, implied harm, and survival scenarios.

Psychological Horror – Themes of fear, tension, and being hunted.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: i5-6600k
  • Graphics: GTX 960
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 100% DirectX 9.0c compatible audio device

short_description: A shadowed forest looms, its hostile residents bound to an ancient evil that is rising again. You bear the heavy burden of an age-old ritual—to keep the demon at bay. Keep the sacred flame burning until dawn, or risk the fate of both yourself and the world.
